title: santa-chain actuals (one runner output file)
description: A runner's output for one chain vector: each entry name -> per-kind result. Retargeting: { nbits, error, note? }; voting: { parameters, activated_update, error, note? }. The union shape (other kind's value keys present-and-null) is legal; graders read only the entry's kind's own fields. `note` may accompany both `panicked` (required, carries the caught-panic message) and `errored` (optional, diagnostic). Normative companion to docs/contract/runner-contract-chain.md §3.

nbits.description: Required-difficulty result for retargeting kind (non-null iff error is null).

parameters.description: Full post-epoch parameters table for voting kind (non-null iff error is null).

activated_update.description: Canonical serializer hex of the activated ErgoValidationSettingsUpdate; "0000" for no activation (non-null iff error is null AND kind is voting; null when error is null AND kind is retargeting).

error.description: Null when a verdict was produced; otherwise the failure mode.

note.description: Panic message when error=="panicked" (required); optional diagnostic when error=="errored". Never graded.

allOf.$comment: error null => at least one kind value field non-null (retargeting: nbits non-null; voting: BOTH parameters AND activated_update non-null). The union shape (other kind fields present-and-null) is still legal.
error non-null => all value fields (nbits, parameters, activated_update) must be null when present.

error == panicked => note required; error == null or 'not-implemented' => note forbidden (contract §3: note is absent for success and not-implemented rows). errored may carry note (optional diagnostic).
